summary.warning: Descriptive, not rules. These are averages of past trades: most of these features were already tested as filters or size tilts in the write-ups below and none passed the adopt test. With 120 trades in 2026 a bucket holds 15-40 trades, so a gap of a few tenths of an R is often noise; 'consistent' only means the same side was better in both 2026 halves by at least 0.1R. Shuffled outcomes (no real link) make 13.3 of 50 features look consistent too.

exit_eff.text: 2026: the trades kept 48% of all the open profit they saw (exit R / best R, summed). 67 of 120 reached +1R: they kept 62% of their best move (median trade 2%) and gave back 1.3R on average; 36 of them ended under +0.5R (mostly breakeven exits). Losers were up 0.36R on average before the stop.
